title: Auth notifications and activity alignment
content:
Auth got a small but important UX pass that pulled Notifications closer to Activity so both pages now feel like parts of the same dashboard.

What changed:
- Notifications now starts directly with the page title and summary, then username/site/trigger filters in the same general rhythm as Activity.
- Per-trigger email settings were reduced into a compact `On | Off` column instead of heavier boxed controls.
- Stable scrollbar spacing was added, and a blank-page regression from a missing React `Fragment` import was fixed.

This matters because Auth is increasingly acting as the shared operational surface for the platform, so consistency and scanability matter more than separate one-off styling.
